# oauth4webapi

`oauth4webapi.mjs` is the unmodified `build/index.js` from npm `oauth4webapi@3.8.8` (MIT, license included). Vendored so the existing dependency-free Pages build and `SKIP_DEPENDENCY_INSTALL=true` remain valid. Source: https://github.com/panva/oauth4webapi . Update deliberately and rerun the authentication tests; never edit the vendor file.
